column6: Utah Business feature on 309th SWEG software engineers (~1650 coders) shipping continuous aircraft software updates; Hill AFB also announced new SWEG workforce-development facilities in March 2026.

Company newsroom carries dated 2026 items through July 2026 including published intracortical-microstimulation safety research; Wired and IEEE Spectrum features on Blackrock-implanted participants in April 2026.
Rio Tinto 6-K Q2 2026 operations review (filed 2026-07-15) reports Bingham Canyon mined copper 20.2kt and Kennecott refined copper 20.4kt for the quarter; South Wall Pushback phase two underway.

Page is scoped to the University of Utah coming online as the fourth ARPANET node on 1969-12-05 — a finished achievement; the original ARPANET itself was decommissioned in 1990, so there is no ongoing doing to find.

Olivera co-authored a May 2026 Protein Science paper characterizing a new MKAVA-family conotoxin; U of U also named him inaugural K. Gordon Lark Endowed Chair in Feb 2026, so the cone-snail venom program is ongoing.

E&S still ships Digistar as a wholly-owned Cosm company from Salt Lake City — this Aug 2025 story covers India first Digistar 2025 install; the flight-simulation half was sold to Rockwell Collins in 2006, so only the graphics/dome line continues.

Page is scoped to John Moses Browning design work in Ogden (Era 1878-1926); ASME landmark record gives his lifespan as 1855-1926, so the designing ended with his death — the Browning Arms brand that survives is a separate subject.

Page is scoped to the development of gene targeting at Utah in the 1980s — a finished method, and activity.md ruling 1 names this page explicitly as concluded; the 2007 Nobel announcement is the dated public record of the completed achievement. Capecchi still runs a Hox/sarcoma lab, but that is not what this page scopes.
The last spike was driven at Promontory Summit on 1869-05-10 — an achievement that is simply over; the NPS unit commemorating it is a separate subject and the original grade was abandoned in 1942.
Fervo (Nasdaq FRVO) filed its Q2 2026 10-Q on 2026-08-13; Cape Station in Beaver County has 500 MW under construction with first power expected late 2026.

Utah 2026 session passed HB 247, HB 410 (2.75M ag-water leasing fund) and HCR 9 plus a 30M US Magnesium water-rights acquisition; the lake is also under continuous USGS gauging and annual Strike Team reporting.

Both instruments are decommissioned: Fly's Eye ran 1981-1993 and HiRes shut down in April 2006 (page Era says 1981-2006); the successor Telescope Array at Delta is a separate subject, and archival HiRes data analysis does not make the instrument active per activity.md ruling 6.

Page is scoped to Fletcher's stereo and psychoacoustics work (1931-1933 landmark); he died 1981-07-23 so the doing ended — activity.md ruling 1 names this case as concluded; the 2016 Grammy is posthumous recognition, not ongoing work.

HELP the homegrown LDS Hospital HIS was replaced by Cerner iCentra; Intermountain CIO Marc Probst said 2020-03-02 the entire organization is on Cerner and the homegrown-system migration is done — later Epic work is a different product. Page Era says 1967-present in successor forms, which conflates HELP with later EHRs.
Hill AFB news dated 2026-05-18 covers the Ogden ALC East Campus groundbreaking for F-35 and T-7A depot facilities; depot sustainment work is ongoing (base website probe returned 403).

Page is scoped to Hall's tetrahedral/cubic press invention work (1955-1970s); Physics Today obituary records his death 2008-07-25 — the industrial descendants (MegaDiamond, US Synthetic) are a separate subject, and cubic-press use worldwide is legacy not ongoing doing on this page.

Intermountain Healthcare Delivery Institute ATP page lists a Fall 2026 virtual course (first session 2026-08-25) and Winter 2027 hybrid dates — a current cycle of the quality-improvement training that is the program's exportable artifact. Wiki Website field points at Wikipedia, not this program page.

Page is scoped to the Jarvik-7 and the Barney Clark implant completed 1982-12-02 at University of Utah Hospital (Anderson first-person account); development Era ends 1990 and SynCardia is a descendant, not this device — activity.md cites Jarvik-7 as the canonical finished S-tier work.

Myriad Q1 2026 earnings (2026-05-05) still lists BRACAnalysis CDx in the Cancer Care Continuum and reports hereditary-cancer testing revenue up 5% YoY — the BRCA test line continues even after the 2013 gene-patent ruling. Page Website is the SCOTUS opinion and sequencing/patent history is a second subject (company page is myriad-genetics.md).
